name: uwe
description: Universeller Welten-Editor — self-hosted campaign brain and world wiki

scripts.quality: pnpm lint && pnpm --filter @uwe/database db:generate && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build:release
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @uwe/database db:generate && turbo run test && node --import tsx --test scripts/selfhost.test.ts scripts/release.test.ts scripts/windows-installer.test.ts scripts/integration-smoke.test.ts
scripts.backup: pnpm --filter @uwe/windows-installer run build && node tools/windows-installer/dist/cli.js backup
scripts.restore: pnpm --filter @uwe/windows-installer run build && node tools/windows-installer/dist/cli.js restore
scripts.doctor: pnpm --filter @uwe/windows-installer run build && node tools/windows-installer/dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.repair: pnpm --filter @uwe/windows-installer run build && node tools/windows-installer/dist/cli.js repair --fix-all
scripts.installer:windows: pnpm --filter @uwe/windows-installer run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/windows/uwe-wizard.ps1
scripts.installer:windows:dry-run: pnpm --filter @uwe/windows-installer run build && node tools/windows-installer/dist/cli.js dry-run --mode dev --repo .
